notes: Pest Insider fact cards (pest-insider/cards.js): one code-drawn picture per lead fact. Each piece is one whole clause of the fact's title or of one lead sentence, copied exactly and cut into before / big / after; it may leave out a source's name or a lead-in clause, never a word like never, not, no, if or only. The check refuses any other words. layout: number (a number in big type), statement (a key phrase in big type), months (the big words name a month range; months = [first, last] lights the month strip), versus (two pieces side by side). tag: a topic from the fixed list in cards.js. scheme: one of the three Waves color sets in cards.js (navy, gold, light), in turn down the file. After any change, draw the new cards: node ops/agents/pest-insider-cards.js --execute
